F1: Profile configuration prevents V1 and V2 admin-permissions features from being enabled together.
F2: V1 token exchange can run with V2 admin permissions and reaches the unconditional UnsupportedOperationException.
F3: The type query excludes untyped per-client resources and can return “Clients” instead of a client UUID.
F4: Existing permission servers are not updated, and the missing Clients fallback resource is dereferenced without a null check.
F5: V2 client deletion leaves UUID-named permission resources and their associated grants behind.
F6: Client permission resources have no display name, so the console renders blank resource labels.
